title: Specified condensed finite-to-Qbar comparison maps
statement: Fix a prime ℓ, a field k of prime characteristic different from ℓ, a finite intermediate coefficient field E in Ω = Qbar_ℓ, and separated finite-type k-schemes as in [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category]. Use the finite-extension-valued condensed Ω-ring and scalar extension T from [prop-weil-pbc-qbar-condensed-two-colimit]. For a k-morphism h:T→U, define the restricted pull comparison T_T l_h,E ≅ l_h,Ω T_U by ObjectProperty.isoMk of derivedPullIso, and the restricted push comparison T_U r_h,E → r_h,Ω T_T by ObjectProperty.homMk of derivedPushHom. For any four k-morphisms f:X→Y, g:Y'→Y, f':X'→Y', g':X'→X, define S_K as the pull comparison at g followed by l_g,Ω of the push comparison at f, and U_K as the push comparison at f' followed by r_f',Ω of the pull comparison at g'. These are precisely the four existing constructions in prop-weil-pbc-qbar-condensed-basechange-compatibility, relocated unchanged; no isomorphy of a push comparison is asserted by this definition.

source.place: Derived section, derivedPullIso and derivedPushHom; original four definitions in Sheaf.Paper.CondensedQbarBaseChangeCompatibility
